description.en: "F91" is now available in all its glory!

description.en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam F91", which is celebrating its 30th theatrical release, Gundam F91 is commercialized as a special specification model with titanium finish!

description.ja: ●　ＭＥＴＡＬＬＩＣ
description.en: ●METALLIC

description.ja: ブルー、イエロー、レッド、オレンジ、グレー等には金属感漂うメタリック成形色を採用。

description.ja: ●　ＳＰＥＣＩＡＬ ＤＩＳＰＬＡＹ

description.ja: 劇中のＭＡラフレシアとの対決シーンをイメージ再現可能な「ラフレシア型台座」が新規パーツを交えて付属。
description.en: A "Rafflesia type pedestal" that allows you to recreate the confrontation scene with MA Rafflesia in the play is included along with new parts.

description.ja: 妖光な輝きを放つメタリックカラーを採用し、テンタクラー・ロッドが付属。
description.en: Adopts a metallic color that gives off a mysterious glow, and comes with a tentacle rod.

description.ja: 劇中終盤の共闘シーンをイメージしたディスプレイが楽しめる新規ディスプレイベースが同梱。
description.en: A new display base is included that allows you to enjoy a display inspired by the joint battle scene at the end of the play.

description.ja: 「ＭＧ 1/100 ガンダムＦ９１ Ｖｅｒ．２．０」などに接続が可能な他、
